title: Clarifying progress indication
summary: Concept work clarifying progress indication in The Pill Club onboarding.

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: Making multi-step eligibility progress easier to understand.
sections.body: Explored clearer progress indication for questionnaire flows.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: Users lost orientation mid-funnel.
sections.body: Long branching questionnaires made it hard to know how far along they were.

sections.label: SOLUTION
sections.title: Visible step structure and calmer interstitial pacing.
sections.body: Concepts that surface section progress without adding cognitive load.

sections.label: OUTCOME
sections.title: Patterns carried into related funnel work.
sections.body: Informed later shipped dermatology funnel patterns.
